title: The Quiet Homecoming
author: Odile Yarrow
blurb: Jonah Coldharbour, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
